summary: Completed Module 07 STEP 1: CONTEXT (Background Jobs & Analytics). Analyzed the hot redirect path decoupling problem, synchronous vs asynchronous analytics tradeoffs, queue failure graceful degradation, and idempotency key design for click events.
evidence: Recorded comprehensive context analysis at progress/evidence/module-07-context.md
